subject: [PATCH v1] mm: unqueue deferred split folios outside the lruvec lock

reviews.summary: Reviewer Lance Yang asked for measurement data to assess whether unqueueing deferred split folios outside the lruvec lock results in measurable overhead and requested before/after numbers on this change

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel to unqueue deferred split folios outside of the lruvec lock, which is held during certain memory management operations. The change introduces a new function, folio_batch_unqueue_deferred_split(), that can be used in these paths to release the folios from the deferred split queue after the lruvec lock has been released but before they are uncharged. This helps reduce contention and shortens critical sections with IRQs disabled.
